decision: How should feature flags be managed?
context: The team ships daily and wants to turn features off without a deploy. There are 3 services in 2 languages, and all of them already use Postgres. A vendor needs a new budget request of 400 dollars a month, while one engineer has 2 weeks free to build tooling.

options.name: vendor
options.text: A hosted feature-flag service with SDKs for both languages and a dashboard

options.name: envvars
options.text: Environment variables read at startup, changed by restarting each service in turn

options.name: configfile
options.text: A JSON flags file kept in the repository and loaded by each service

options.name: dbtable
options.text: A flags table in Postgres that each service polls every 10 minutes
